name: GFC. Ltd.
summary: GFC. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells elevators, escalators, and generators in Taiwan. It operates in three segments: Sales, Maintenance, and GFC Shanghai. The company offers passenger, high speed, and home elevators, as well as escalators/moving walks and pneumatic vacuum elevators. It is also involved in sale and manufacture of elevators and parts; sale of vacuum pneumatic shuttle; and sale and installation of diesel generators. The company's products are used in offices and factories, shopping malls, hotels, mansions, hospitals, public constructions, and institutes projects. GFC. Ltd. was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. GFC. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Changjiang Property Co., Ltd.
